Hey Voat. As of yesterday, I have been a goat for a full year. Like many of you, I came from that other website. After becoming sick of the crap going on there, I found out there was an alternative and immediately slid down here. Haven't gone back since, and I don't plan to.

It's been very cool watching Voat grow, and I am very impressed at the quality of post and comments. Thanks to everyone participating, keep doing what you're doing.

Here is my advice on how we can make Voat better:

  1. This one is the most important. Post in smaller subverses! So many niche and specific subs on here are essentially dead, but the same are active on the other website. Part of what makes the place great is to be able to connect with communities of people that share a common interest, even if it is something small. Before posting something in /v/whatever (or any other sub) , maybe look and see if there is a more appropriate place to post it. And if you still want the good exposure, post it in both, but say you are cross-posting it from the smaller sub. Many people I have talked to and tried to get on Voat specifically said they don't want to because all the small subs are inactive. Advertise your small sub and get people to come on over, check it out, and maybe post some stuff. Heck, if you want to do some shameless advertising in these comments, be my guest!

  2. Get the word out about Voat. On other forums and websites, mention voat and get people curious. Having more people here is undoubtebly a good thing. Just make sure they follow the rules and don't act like idiots.

  3. Avoid the echo chamber. One thing a lot of us complain about the other site was it's hivemind and the same opinions being tossed around with but different words. It's why some of us left and came here, and it could be the reason others leave Voat or never join. It's fine to post something most people here would agree with, but be sure it is tasteful and actually adds to the discussion. If you have a "dissenting" opinion, please comment or post it! It is very refreshing to hear and more people may agree with you than you think. This is how we can keep subs vibrant, interesting, and fun. And this doesn't end at opinions either. For example, /r/music (the other site) was considered an echo chamber of indie rock and alternative. Let's have /v/music be diversified and interesting. And if you don't like the post/comment, look at #5.

  4. Keep posts where they belong. Don't post politics in /v/whatever , post it in /v/politics , for example. Remember that /v/whatever isn't a dumping ground, it is for things that don't go anywhere else. And that goes for every sub. Making sure everything is in the right place helps Voat not seem like a huge site-wide circlejerk of variants on one topic.

  5. Mind the downvoat. This is more of reminder than anything else, most of you do this very well. Only downvoat if something is spam, etc, etc. Do not downvoat for things you disagree with, and if you are ever in doubt, don't downvoat.

  6. Stop lurking! Comment, post, do something! We have a nice little playground here, don't stand on the side and watch. An active community is very important to Voat!

  7. Be nice. That's it.

That's everything I can think of right now, but I might be coming back soon to add some stuff. But again, thanks for being great Voat!
